memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  - Status: Moderate lower back pain radiating to left leg, positive straight leg raise on left, pain score 6/10.
  - Plan: Start pregabalin 75 mg twice daily, diclofenac 50 mg twice daily after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg once daily. Advise avoidance of prolonged sitting, lumbar support cushion. Review in 6 weeks.
Weight: 58 kg; Waist: 78 cm (below female cutoff of 80 cm).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
pregabalin 75 mg BD after food for 4 weeks
 diclofenac 50 mg BD after food for 4 weeks
 methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD for 4 weeks

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Vitamin B12: 210 pg/mL (reference 200-900)
 ESR: 18 mm/hr (reference 0-20)
 CRP: 3 mg/L (reference <5)

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Straight leg raise test: Positive at 40 degrees on left, negative on right. Suggests L5/S1 radiculopathy.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: MRI lumbar spine: Mild disc bulge at L4-L5 causing left foraminal narrowing; no cord compression.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: X-ray lumbar spine: No fracture or degenerative changes; lumbar lordosis preserved.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Allergy: Diclofenac - developed mild rash and itching after first dose; discontinued.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  - Status: Improved pain, now 3/10, occasional tingling left foot. No rash since stopping diclofenac.
  - Plan: Continue pregabalin 75 mg BD, add baclofen 5 mg TDS for muscle spasm, continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Advise core strengthening exercises. Review in 8 weeks.
Weight: 57 kg; Waist: 77 cm (below female cutoff of 80 cm).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
pregabalin 75 mg BD after food for 8 weeks
 baclofen 5 mg TDS after food for 8 weeks
 methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD for 8 weeks

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Vitamin B12: 260 pg/mL (reference 200-900)
 ESR: 12 mm/hr (reference 0-20)
 CRP: 2 mg/L (reference <5)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Message via clinic app: 'My lower back pain has worsened again after long drives; I need stronger pain relief.'

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  - Status: Pain back to 5/10 after increased work hours; mild muscle tightness.
  - Plan: Increase pregabalin to 100 mg BD, continue baclofen 5 mg TDS, continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Add topical NSAID gel as needed. Review in 6 weeks.
Weight: 58 kg; Waist: 78 cm (below female cutoff of 80 cm).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
pregabalin 100 mg BD after food for 6 weeks
 baclofen 5 mg TDS after food for 6 weeks
 methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD for 6 weeks

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-07-05 10:30 with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for follow-up review of sciatica.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  - Status: Pain stable at 4/10, tolerable with current meds; no new neurological deficit.
  - Plan: Continue pregabalin 100 mg BD, baclofen 5 mg TDS, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Add physiotherapy referral for core strengthening. Review in 3 months.
Weight: 58 kg; Waist: 78 cm (below female cutoff of 80 cm).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Physiotherapy Department, Sunrise Family Clinic, for core strengthening and lumbar stabilization exercises. Please assess and provide treatment plan.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Physiotherapy report: Patient attended 6 sessions, showed improved lumbar range of motion and reduced pain scores to 2/10. Advised to continue home exercises.
